summary: Porch Group's managed reciprocal and subsidiary HOA Holdco agreed on October 13, 2026 to acquire Allied Trust Insurance, its MGA, and captive reinsurer from Allied Trust Holdings for $200.0 million total. ATIC fetches $105.0 million, split into $55.0 million at closing and $50.0 million deferred over twelve monthly installments, while the MGA and Lonestar interests cost $95.0 million cash at closing. Up to $20.0 million of closing consideration and $50.0 million of deferred payments may be settled in Porch stock, priced off the prior Nasdaq close, with resale registration required.
